prompt: Add file attachments to notes. POST /notes/{note_id}/attachments with JSON {"filename": "<name>", "content": "<text>"} stores the file and returns 201. GET /notes/{note_id}/attachments lists the note's attachment filenames, and GET /notes/{note_id}/attachments/{filename} returns {"filename": ..., "content": ...}, or 404 if there's no such attachment. Anyone who can open the note (its owner, or someone it's shared with) can list and read its attachments; only the owner can upload. Store the files on disk under the folder named by the NOTES_FILES environment variable (default "attachments").
